VOICE MEMO 7 — 11/08/2026 — 4:17 AM — 3 min 41 s

[Automatic transcription. Checked by hand by H.W.]

[rain. A lighter that doesn't catch the first time.]

Okay. Seven. Memo seven. For the record, it's four-something and I'm not drunk, I'm tired, which is worse.

Third confirmed case. Kyle Brandt, twenty-three, Crown Hill. His mother found him Tuesday. County report: fentanyl overdose. His mother says he was terrified of needles, that he used to pass out at school when they gave shots. I believe her. Not because she's his mother. I believe her because he doesn't have a single old mark on his arms and because my source at the M.E.'s office told me the same thing again that they told me about the other two.

[long pause]

That they're missing blood. Not all of it. Some. Like someone took just enough.

Three in eighteen months, inside a one-mile radius. All three at night, all three alone, all three in houses with no alarm. And one more thing, and this is the one keeping me up. I requested the cameras. The ones at the 7-Eleven on Kyle's corner, the bus stop, the building across the street. All three “failed” that night. Between one and three. All three.

I don't know if that's a person or a system. I don't know which scares me more, either.

[pause. Exhales smoke.]

To do: cross-check against the Harbor Island folder. To do: don't tell Nadia about this yet, she gets excited and wants to run it in the next episode, and this isn't ready. To do, even though I'm not going to: tell the man on the phone.

No. Not yet. If I tell him, he takes it out of my hands.

End of memo.

Medium: audio transcript. When: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.T8gJWjZpOnL4OisP]{A1-E01 · What They Took}, if Helen lets the coterie go through her phone, or as reading ahead of session 1.

Foreshadows: the pattern of the Ballard deaths, which is part of the File. The cameras that “didn't record anything” are the first sign of Gale Sentinel (@UUID[JournalEntry.j32Ohis1qKJB3jcx.JournalEntryPage.NIaBWn52GOUI61A5]{Professional Mortal Thieves; Looped Cameras}).

Truth: everything she says is true. The three deaths are the work of a minor Kindred who was feeding without control in Crown Hill. It has no connection to Halloway, but it's one of the holes FIRSTLIGHT will find in the archive.
